sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm SiC/carbon EPDM – complete package for full allocation from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation and for being clear about the capacity situation. We understand that firm, long-term commitments matter to your planning, so here is a complete package that gives you exactly that:

- Unit price: EUR 29.89
- Volume: 23,400 pcs per year
- Contract term: 24 months
- Lead time: 56 days

If agreed, the annual quantity would be binding for the full term. Payment, DAP delivery and the 2027-01-01 start remain as in our enquiry.

We offer the firm commitment and the longer lead time to make your production planning easier. We recognise that they do not, by themselves, create physical capacity. That is why we would value your view on whether this works on your side.

Could you support this complete package with full allocation of our 23,400 pcs per year? If something in it makes that difficult, please tell us which point it is. We are glad to look at it together with you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm SiC/carbon EPDM – complete package for full allocation from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can confirm the requested allocation of 23,400 units per year and the 56-day lead time. While the 24-month commitment assists our planning, your proposed price is not viable. 

We offer a revised unit price of EUR 31.90 for this package, provided you share the data supporting your volume projections. For our planning, our offer consists of a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm: full allocation, 36 months, and our calculation basis
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming the full 23,400 pcs per year and the 56-day lead time. On your question: we can commit to 23,400 pcs per year, binding for the whole term, so the volume commitment rests with us.

We have changed two points. The unit price rises from EUR 29.89 to EUR 30.90, and we add a third binding year. The package is now 36 months at 23,400 pcs/year with a 56-day lead time.

Our calculation basis: Our July 2026 buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010). Its components are EUR 3.40 material, EUR 14.64 conversion and EUR 6.27 overhead per unit. This is our own bottom-up estimate, not your data, and your actual costs may differ. EUR 30.90 leaves room above it.

If the estimate misses something, such as specialised production, please tell us which cost category or capacity consideration it is. We do not need detailed figures.

If you can support approval, we can conclude on this complete package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm: full allocation, 36 months, and our calculation basis
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your 36-month commitment and your cost estimate; however, our specialized production and high utilization dictate our actual costs. 

We accept the extended 36-month term and propose a revised price of EUR 31.40 per unit. This adjustment reflects the value of the longer commitment while securing the necessary capacity for your full allocation. Please note that our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our offer stands at a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
